articles.title: B.C. woman's plan after winning $100K Lotto Max prize starts with margaritas
articles.summary: The Port Alberni winner kept the news quiet for a few days before revealing the six-figure prize at her husband's birthday dinner
articles.body:
A B.C. woman has a few plans for her $100,000 Lotto Max win, but she knows how she wants to celebrate first.

Nora G., of Port Alberni, won a Maxplus prize in the Aug. 11, 20 Lotto Max draw and says margaritas are in order before she turns her attention to paying off the mortgage and helping her kids.

"I was in the kitchen at home when I found out I won," said Nora. "When I saw the prize amount [on the BCLC Lotto! App] I was shocked."

Her husband was the first person to hear the news, but the couple decided not to tell the rest of the family right away. Instead, they kept the $100,000 win to themselves for a few days before Nora chose the perfect moment to share it with their children.

"Once I told my husband, we waited a few days, then I let our kids know at my husband's birthday dinner," she said.

The family suddenly had two reasons to celebrate that night, and Nora said she already has another celebration in mind now that the prize has been claimed — margaritas.

After that, her plans become a little more practical. Nora told BCLC she intends to use the money to pay off her mortgage and help her children.

The winning ticket was purchased at Petro Canada on Hyde Creek Road in Port McNeill.

Lotto Max draws take place every Tuesday and Friday, with jackpots starting at $10 million and growing up to $90 million. Tickets cost $6 and include four selections of seven numbers. Every Lotto Max draw also includes multiple $100,000 cash prizes, called "Maxplus". For every $1 million in the main jackpot, a $100,000 prize is added to the draw.

articles.title: Lady Gaga photographer puts Suffolk's 'sandals vicar' on show
articles.summary: Tim Walker includes the Right Reverend Andrew Dotchin in his new National Portrait Gallery exhibit.
articles.body:
A photographer who has captured Chappell Roan and Lady Gaga has chosen a sandal-loving vicar to feature in a new National Portrait Gallery exhibit.

Tim Walker's show Fairyland: Love and Legends is described as an exploration of queer identity, community and love, in which the photographer spent five years shooting activists, performers, artists and writers - including the Reverend Andrew Dotchin from Ipswich, Suffolk.

"It's beyond my wildest dreams and just such a privilege to be there," Dotchin told BBC Radio Suffolk's Matt Marvel.

During his career, Dotchin forged links with Suffolk Pride and conducted one of the first same-sex partnership blessings at a Church of England service.

Dotchin became well-known in Suffolk for his love of wearing sandals and he revealed that he was wearing them under his robes in his portrait.

The portrait of Dotchin was taken when he led the same-sex blessing of the Reverend Catherine Bond and the Reverend Jane Pearce in Felixstowe in 2023.

The couple, who are both priests in the seaside town, also feature in the exhibition.

The service followed the Church of England's decision that year to sanction blessing's for same-sex couples .

"I've been privileged to be at a place where people who want to celebrate their love can, and have found a safe place in the communities I've worshipped with," Dotchin said.

"Down the years, right back to the very beginning of my being a vicar 40-odd years ago, I've always been welcomed by the lesbian and gay community.

"To finally be in a place where the church said these people deserve to be blessed, and have the whole parish celebrate that love is love."

His, Bond's and Pearce's portraits hang alongside famous faces including Alan Carr, Sir Ian McKellen and Sandi Toksvig.

articles.title: Prefeito de Petrópolis anuncia novo secretário de Defesa Civil | G1
articles.standfirst: Anúncio foi feito ao lado do comandante-geral do Corpo de Bombeiros, coronel Tarciso Salles. Nomeação reforça parceria entre município e Estado para ampliar ações de prevenção a desastres naturais.
articles.summary: Anúncio foi feito ao lado do comandante-geral do Corpo de Bombeiros, coronel Tarciso Salles. Nomeação reforça parceria entre município e Estado.
articles.body:
Segundo a prefeitura, a chegada de Vinícius Fernandes reforça a parceria entre o município e o Governo do Estado — Foto: Prefeitura

O prefeito de Petrópolis (RJ), Hingo Hammes, anunciou o coronel Vinícius Fernandes como novo secretário de Proteção e Defesa Civil do município.

A nomeação foi divulgada nesta terça-feira (13), ao lado do secretário de Estado de Defesa Civil e comandante-geral do Corpo de Bombeiros do Rio de Janeiro, coronel Tarciso Salles.

A mudança ocorre após o pedido de exoneração do tenente-coronel Guilherme Moraes, na última quinta-feira (8) . Ao deixar o cargo, ele alegou falta de estrutura e investimentos, principalmente diante dos possíveis impactos do fenômeno El Niño.

Segundo a prefeitura, a chegada de Vinícius Fernandes reforça a parceria entre o município e o Governo do Estado para ampliar as ações de prevenção, monitoramento e resposta a situações de emergência.

Com quase 30 anos de experiência no Corpo de Bombeiros, o novo secretário tem atuação na Região Serrana e já ocupou cargos estratégicos na corporação.

Atualmente, ele comanda a Área 2, na Serra, e também já esteve à frente da Área 1, na capital, além de ter atuado como coordenador de Avaliação de Cenário do Gabinete de Segurança Institucional (GSI) do Estado do Rio de Janeiro.

O novo secretário afirmou que sua gestão terá como prioridades o fortalecimento das equipes, o planejamento preventivo, o aprimoramento do monitoramento e a integração entre órgãos municipais e estaduais. A prefeitura informou ainda que a prevenção de desastres e a proteção da população seguirão como prioridades da administração municipal.

articles.title: Doação de sangue em Petrolina e medula óssea: confira a campanha | G1
articles.standfirst: Projeto 'Coren-PE + Vida' mobiliza estudantes, profissionais de saúde e a população em geral. O público deve comparecer ao Hemocentro de Petrolina das 7h às 12h.
articles.summary: A campanha de doação de sangue em Petrolina e cadastro de medula ocorre no Hemocentro nesta quarta e quinta, das 7h às 12h, em parceria com o Hemope.
articles.body:
Ação do Coren/PE e Hemocentro incentiva doação de sangue e cadastro de medula óssea nesta quarta (14) e quinta-feira (15) em Petrolina — Foto: Ascom/ Coren/PE

Uma ação para incentivar a doação de sangue e o cadastro de doadores de medula óssea será realizada nesta quarta-feira (14) e quinta-feira (15) em Petrolina , no Sertão de Pernambuco. A iniciativa faz parte do projeto 'Coren-PE + Vida', uma parceria entre o Conselho Regional de Enfermagem de Pernambuco (Coren-PE) e a Fundação Hemope.

Representantes do conselho estarão na cidade para mobilizar estudantes, profissionais de enfermagem e a população em geral. As doações e cadastros devem ser feitos diretamente na unidade do Hemocentro de Petrolina, localizado na Rua Pacífico da Luz, s/n, no Centro, das 7h às 12h.

Ter entre 16 e 69 anos (menores de 18 anos devem estar acompanhados por um responsável legal);

Pessoas que nunca doaram podem se candidatar até os 60 anos, 11 meses e 29 dias;

Estar em boas condições de saúde, bem alimentado e descansado.

Requisitos para doação de doação voluntários de Medula Óssea

Para integrar o Registro Brasileiro de Doadores Voluntários de Medula Óssea (Redome), o interessado deve realizar um cadastro no próprio hemocentro. No local, é feita uma coleta de uma pequena amostra de sangue para o teste de compatibilidade (exame de HLA).

Os dados são inseridos no sistema nacional, o que possibilita que o voluntário seja localizado caso surja um receptor compatível em qualquer parte do mundo.

O projeto já passou pelos municípios de Salgueiro, Ouricuri, Garanhuns, Caruaru, Serra Talhada e Arcoverde. Nas três primeiras edições, realizadas no Recife, a mobilização reuniu mais de 250 voluntários.

Outras informações sobre o projeto e o calendário de ações estão disponíveis no site do Coren-PE (clique aqui).

articles.title: Caraguatatuba promove mais de 50 ações de saúde da mulher durante o Outubro Rosa | G1
articles.standfirst: Programação da Prefeitura inclui exames preventivos, orientações sobre mamografia, vacinação e atividades de conscientização em diferentes regiões do município.
articles.summary: Programação da Prefeitura inclui exames preventivos, orientações sobre mamografia, vacinação e atividades de conscientização em diferentes regiões do município.
articles.body:
O Governo Municipal de Caraguatatuba preparou uma ampla mobilização para o Outubro Rosa 2026. Com o tema “Outubro Rosa: Cuidar de si também é um ato de amor”, a Prefeitura, por meio da Secretaria de Saúde, promove durante todo o mês mais de 50 ações voltadas à prevenção, ao diagnóstico precoce e ao cuidado integral com a saúde da mulher.

As atividades serão realizadas em diferentes regiões do município e envolvem 12 Unidades Básicas de Saúde (UBSs), o Centro de Referência em Saúde da Mulher (CRSM), o Centro de Especialidades Médicas e Odontológicas (CEM/CEO), o Fundo Social de Caraguatatuba e outros espaços comunitários.

Entre os serviços e atividades estão coleta de exame preventivo (Papanicolau), orientações e solicitação de mamografia, testes rápidos para Infecções Sexualmente Transmissíveis (ISTs), vacinação, palestras, rodas de conversa e ações de educação e autocuidado.

Durante o mês, algumas unidades terão períodos de porta aberta, sem necessidade de agendamento prévio, para atendimento e realização de procedimentos. A campanha também chegará a espaços comunitários, como feiras livres, associações de bairro e comércio local, ampliando o acesso às informações e aos serviços de saúde.

“Mais do que uma campanha, o Outubro Rosa é um movimento de cuidado que precisa estar presente no cotidiano das mulheres. Por isso, nosso trabalho foi construído para ampliar o acesso à informação, à prevenção e aos serviços de saúde, aproximando as ações dos diferentes territórios de Caraguatatuba”, destaca Derci Andolfo, Secretaria Adjunta de Saúde.

A programação inicia na quinta, dia 1º de outubro, com uma iniciativa realizada pelo Fundo Social de Caraguatatuba, na Secretaria de Serviços Públicos. A atividade será voltada a mais de 250 mulheres, entre servidoras efetivas, colaboradoras da Molise e integrantes do Programa Emergencial de Auxílio-Desemprego (PEAD).

Já no sábado, 3 de outubro, a Praça da Cultura recebe um evento especial de conscientização, das 9h às 11h. A programação terá aulão ritmado, orientações sobre a prevenção dos cânceres de mama e do colo do útero, triagem odontológica e vacinação.

A população também é convidada a vestir rosa e participar da mobilização, reforçando a mensagem de conscientização e cuidado que marca o Outubro Rosa.

Nas semanas seguintes, as UBSs receberão atividades sobre prevenção dos cânceres de mama e do colo do útero, saúde sexual, sífilis, autocuidado, mamografia e coleta de preventivo, além de mutirões e períodos de atendimento em livre demanda.

A agenda contempla ainda diferentes aspectos da saúde feminina, com orientações sobre os direitos das mulheres em tratamento oncológico, palestras sobre climatério e reposição hormonal, atividades de bem-estar e autoestima e ações de saúde bucal.

O encerramento será no sábado, 24 de outubro, com uma mobilização integrada entre o CEM/CEO, o CRSM, o Fundo Social e as UBSs do município.

No CEM/CEO e CRSM, das 8h às 17h, serão realizadas ações de coleta de preventivo, orientações sobre saúde da mulher, triagem odontológica e avaliações relacionadas ao câncer bucal e às próteses dentárias.

Também estão previstas roda de conversa sobre prevenção e autocuidado, aula especial de Dança do Ventre, palestra sobre climatério e reposição hormonal e um café especial promovido pelo Fundo Social de Caraguatatuba com pacientes oncológicas.

Paralelamente, as UBSs do município realizarão o Dia D da Coleta de Preventivo, das 8h às 17h e as salas de vacina também estarão abertas das 8h às 12h.

Além das atividades com datas específicas, quatro ações estarão disponíveis de forma contínua durante outubro:

UBS Perequê-Mirim: convocação para coleta citopatológica no território;

UBS Rio do Ouro: solicitação de mamografias em sistema de porta aberta;

UBS Golfinhos: testes rápidos de sífilis;

UBS Porto Novo: todas as sextas-feiras, ações de preventivo, mamografia e saúde da mulher.

A estratégia amplia as oportunidades de acesso e reforça uma das principais mensagens do Outubro Rosa: o cuidado pode fazer parte da rotina e não precisa esperar uma única data ou uma única campanha.

articles.title: Alerta de chuva em BH: Defesa Civil prevê raios e ventos de 50 km/h | G1
articles.standfirst: Aviso é válido até as 8h desta quarta-feira (14). Órgão recomenda evitar áreas de alagamento e não se abrigar debaixo de árvores.
articles.summary: O alerta de chuva em BH da Defesa Civil vale até quarta-feira (14) e orienta a população a evitar áreas de inundação e árvores durante as rajadas.
articles.body:
Alerta da Defesa Civil e céu de Belo Horizonte na manhã desta terça-feira (13) — Foto: Reprodução/TV Globo

A Defesa Civil de Belo Horizonte emitiu, nesta terça-feira (13), um alerta para a possibilidade de chuva com raios e rajadas de vento em torno de 50 km/h. O aviso é válido até as 8h desta quarta-feira (14).

O órgão recomenda que a população redobre a atenção durante a chuva e evite circular em ruas sujeitas a alagamentos ou perto de córregos e ribeirões. A orientação também é ter atenção especial a áreas de encostas e morros.

Não atravesse ruas alagadas nem deixe crianças brincarem em enxurradas ou perto de córregos.

Não se abrigue nem estacione veículos debaixo de árvores.

Não se aproxime de cabos elétricos rompidos. Nesses casos, ligue para a Cemig, pelo 116, ou para a Defesa Civil, pelo 199.

Se perceber rachaduras nas paredes das casas ou o surgimento de fendas, depressões ou minas d’água no terreno, avise imediatamente a Defesa Civil.

Em caso de raios, não permaneça em áreas abertas nem use equipamentos elétricos.

Os moradores de Belo Horizonte podem receber gratuitamente os alertas da Defesa Civil por SMS. Para se cadastrar, basta enviar uma mensagem de texto com o CEP da rua onde moram para o número 40199. Uma mensagem de confirmação será enviada na sequência.

Os avisos também podem ser acompanhados pelo canal público da Defesa Civil de BH no WhatsApp, pelas redes sociais Instagram, Facebook e X e pelo canal do Telegram, no endereço defesacivilbh.

articles.title: Will NATO’s ‘theory of victory’ work?
articles.summary: The alliance presents a common vision to deter adversaries.
articles.body:
NATO says it does not want war, but it is ready to fight.

The message was delivered by its top military commander, as he outlined a new plan to defend its territory.

It involves low-cost drones, artificial intelligence, and rapid strikes to deter any potential attack on member states.

NATO has been undergoing a strategic shift, after the United States announced it would withdraw thousands of troops from Europe.

But that’s just one factor pushing leaders to increase military budgets.

They’re also worried about what they say is a growing threat from Russia.

Will the new strategy address that threat?

articles.title: Feriados em Alagoas 2026: Próxima folga será em novembro | G1
articles.standfirst: Dia de Finados cairá em uma segunda-feira. Data vai garantir três dias seguidos de descanso para quem folga aos fins de semana.
articles.summary: Os feriados em Alagoas 2026 reservam três períodos de descanso prolongado até o fim do ano, começando pelo Dia de Finados em uma segunda-feira.
articles.body:
O próximo feriadão em Alagoas será no dia 2 de novembro, quando é celebrado o Dia de Finados. A data cairá em uma segunda-feira e pode garantir três dias consecutivos de descanso para trabalhadores que folgam aos sábados e domingos.

Ao todo, ainda restam quatro feriados nacionais em 2026. Desses, três poderão proporcionar fins de semana prolongados: Finados, Dia da Consciência Negra e Natal.

Em novembro, serão três feriados. Além do Dia de Finados, a Proclamação da República, celebrada no dia 15, cairá em um domingo. Já o Dia da Consciência Negra, em 20 de novembro, será em uma sexta-feira.

O último feriado nacional do ano será o Natal, em 25 de dezembro, também em uma sexta-feira.

Calendário de feriados 2026, em Campinas — Foto: Arte/g1

Veja os próximos feriados nacionais de 2026

2 de novembro (segunda-feira): Dia de Finados;

15 de novembro (domingo): Proclamação da República;

20 de novembro (sexta-feira): Dia da Consciência Negra;

Além dos feriados nacionais, o calendário ainda prevê três pontos facultativos que podem garantir folgas para parte dos trabalhadores, principalmente servidores públicos.

28 de outubro (quarta-feira): Dia do Servidor Público;

24 de dezembro (quinta-feira): véspera de Natal, após as 13h;

31 de dezembro (quinta-feira): véspera de Ano Novo, após as 13h.

Quem trabalha no feriado tem direito a folga?

Orla de Maceió — Foto: Charlene Araújo/TV Asa Branca Alagoas

Nem todos os trabalhadores têm folga garantida nos feriados. A legislação permite o funcionamento de serviços essenciais e de outras atividades autorizadas.

Quem trabalha durante um feriado pode ter direito ao pagamento em dobro ou a uma folga compensatória, conforme as regras trabalhistas aplicáveis.

Já os pontos facultativos não garantem folga obrigatória a trabalhadores da iniciativa privada. Nesses casos, a liberação depende da decisão do empregador ou de acordos específicos.

articles.title: Barragem de Aimorés terá novos bloqueios em outubro; veja datas | G1
articles.standfirst: Após interdições noturnas iniciadas em setembro, travessia terá novos bloqueios em cinco dias de outubro, das 8h às 17h. Motoristas terão que utilizar rotas alternativas.
articles.summary: Após interdições em setembro, passagem pela barragem de Aimorés será fechada durante o dia em cinco datas de outubro. Veja horários e rotas alternativas.
articles.body:
Barragem Usina Hidrelétrica de Aimorés — Foto: Divulgação

A passagem de veículos pela barragem da Usina Hidrelétrica de Aimorés voltará a ser interrompida em outubro, desta vez também durante o dia. Após os bloqueios noturnos iniciados em setembro, a travessia será totalmente fechada nos dias 14, 15, 16, 19 e 26, das 8h às 17h.

Segundo a Aliança Energia, os novos bloqueios serão necessários para a realização de testes nas comportas do vertedouro da usina e vão afetar motoristas que utilizam a barragem para se deslocar entre áreas rurais de Baixo Guandu , no Espírito Santo, e Aimorés, Itueta e Resplendor , no Leste de Minas.

As interdições na passagem pela barragem começaram em setembro , quando o trânsito foi interrompido durante a noite para obras de modernização dos equipamentos do vertedouro. Na ocasião, os bloqueios ocorreram das 22h às 5h.

Na época, a administração da usina já havia informado sobre a previsão de novas interrupções. Agora, além dos bloqueios noturnos, a travessia também será fechada durante o dia para a realização de testes nas comportas.

Além das interdições durante o dia, os bloqueios noturnos continuam até novembro. Nas noites de 15 e 16 de outubro, a passagem também será interrompida das 22h às 5h.

Veja as datas e os horários dos bloqueios

De acordo com a Aliança Energia, os bloqueios durante o dia serão necessários para a realização de testes de abertura controlada das comportas do vertedouro, sem liberação de água. O procedimento ocorre anualmente, antes do início do período de chuvas.

Durante os serviços, um caminhão-guindaste ocupará toda a largura da pista sobre a barragem, impedindo a passagem de veículos.

Já as interdições noturnas, iniciadas em setembro, fazem parte das obras de modernização dos equipamentos do vertedouro. Os trabalhos continuarão até novembro, segundo a empresa.

Para quem precisa circular pela região durante as interdições, a Aliança Energia indica duas alternativas: a estrada do Baixio e a estrada vicinal de Resplendor .

Pela estrada do Baixio , o trajeto apresentado no mapa passa pelas localidades de Pedra Lorena, Pedra do Resplendor, Rala Toba e Rampa Sanches, seguindo até Santo Antônio do Rio Doce, em Aimorés. O percurso indicado tem 29,3 quilômetros, com tempo estimado de 46 minutos de carro.

Pela estrada vicinal de Resplendor , o trajeto passa por Pedra Lorena, Pedra do Resplendor e pela estrada Boa Sorte, em Itueta, seguindo em direção a Resplendor. O percurso apresentado no mapa tem 33,8 quilômetros, com previsão de 54 minutos de viagem de carro.

Desvio durante as interdições na barragem da UHE de Aimorés podem ser feitas pela estrada do Baixio (mapa 1) ou pela estrada vicinal de Resplendor (mapa 2) — Foto: Reprodução/Google Maps

As distâncias e os tempos são estimativas apresentadas pelo Google Maps e podem variar conforme as condições das vias e do trânsito.

A Aliança Energia orienta os motoristas a programarem os deslocamentos com antecedência e considerarem um tempo maior de viagem durante os bloqueios.

A Usina Hidrelétrica de Aimorés foi inaugurada em maio de 2006 e tem capacidade instalada de 330 megawatts (MW).

articles.title: Papa Leão XIV é diagnosticado com câncer de pulmão após retirada de nó | G1
articles.standfirst: Pontífice, de 71 anos, passou por cirurgia para retirar tumor. Procedimento durou 90 minutos e foi concluído com sucesso.
articles.summary: Exames identificaram adenocarcinoma pulmonar após cirurgia para retirar um nódulo do pulmão direito do pontífice nesta terça-feira (13).
articles.body:
O papa Leão XIV foi diagnosticado nesta terça-feira (13) com adenocarcinoma pulmonar , um tipo de câncer no pulmão, informou o Vaticano . O pontífice passou por uma cirurgia e precisou retirar a parte inferior do pulmão direito, onde estava localizado o tumor.

Segundo a nota assinada pelo médico Luigi Carbone e pelo professor Stefano Margaritora, os exames realizados antes da cirurgia já apontavam para o diagnóstico , que foi confirmado durante a operação.

A equipe, composta por mais dois médicos, decidiu retirar o lobo inferior do pulmão de Leão por meio de técnica videoassistida.

A cirurgia durou cerca de 90 minutos, foi concluída com sucesso e não teve complicações. Leão XIV acordou normalmente e voltou ao quarto do hospital, onde se recupera.

A nota não mencionou quais serão os próximos passos do tratamento, e o Vaticano afirmou que, por enquanto, os médicos não estão falando em quimioterapia ou outras terapias, enquanto aguardam os resultados de outros exames.

Segundo a agência de notícias Associated Press, médicos tiveram de aplicar uma anestesia geral e realizaram uma biópsia na lesão após a remoção.

A AP afirmou que cirurgia teve início após profissionais de saúde rezarem o terço na capela do hospital.

“Vamos nos unir em oração, pedindo ao Senhor que ampare nosso bispo, o papa Leão, e conforte todos aqueles que estão hospitalizados aqui”, disse o vigário de Roma , cardeal Baldassare Reina, durante a oração, segundo fontes da AP.

A cirurgia estava prevista para iniciar às 11h no horário de Brasília, porém o pontífice chegou ao hospital Gemelli cerca de 1h após o horário inicialmente previsto, o que acabou atrasando o início do procedimento.

O procedimento, revelado no fim de semana pelo próprio papa, foi recomendado após médicos detectarem uma lesão em seu pulmão. O anúncio surpreendeu fiéis durante oração na Praça de São Pedro.

O pontífice, de 71 anos, não tem nenhum outro problema de saúde conhecido.

Papa Francisco antes de cirurgia para retirada de tumor do pulmão. — Foto: Guglielmo Mangiapane/Reuters

Durante a missa no último domingo (11), o pontífice afirmou que o nódulo foi detectado em estágio inicial e seu crescimento está "bem controlado" . Ainda assim, afirmou o papa, médicos recomendaram a cirurgia para a remoção .

“Queridos amigos, durante alguns exames médicos recentes, os médicos encontraram um nódulo localizado em meu pulmão. Ele foi detectado em um estágio muito inicial e está bem localizado. Os médicos consideram a cirurgia adequada. Seguindo a orientação deles, decidi, portanto, submeter-me a uma operação para removê-lo. A cirurgia já está agendada para os próximos dias. Agradeço pela proximidade espiritual de vocês e confio-me às suas orações", disse o papa aos fiéis.

O papa Leão XIV cumprimenta o médico Andrea Cambieri ao chegar ao hospital Gemelli para uma cirurgia de retirada de um nódulo no pulmão, em 13 de outubro de 2026. — Foto: Guglielmo Mangiapane/ Reuters

O porta-voz do Vaticano, Matteo Bruni, afirmou que recuperação do pontífice após a cirurgia deverá levar cerca de uma semana. Por isso, na última segunda-feira (12), o papa cancelou toda a sua agenda de atividades até 20 de outubro . Durante o período de internação, Leão XIV deverá continuar trabalhando a partir do hospital, como já ocorreu com outros pontífices.

articles.title: Sumaré transfere atendimento do CTEA do Centro para a Casa do Autista | G1
articles.standfirst: Mudança amplia estrutura para atendimento especializado de crianças e adolescentes com Transtorno do Espectro Autista
articles.summary: Mudança amplia estrutura para atendimento especializado de crianças e adolescentes com Transtorno do Espectro Autista
articles.body:
Sumaré transfere atendimento do CTEA do Centro para a Casa do Autista — Foto: Crédito: Divulgação

A Unidade Móvel do Programa Agora Tem Especialistas, do Ministério da Saúde, em parceria A Prefeitura de Sumaré, por meio da Secretaria Municipal de Saúde, transferiu para a Casa do Autista o acompanhamento das crianças e adolescentes atendidos pelo CTEA (Centro de Transtorno do Espectro do Autismo) do Centro. A mudança amplia a estrutura destinada ao atendimento especializado de pessoas com Transtorno do Espectro Autista (TEA) e seus familiares.

Segundo a Secretaria de Saúde, a transferência tem como objetivo oferecer um espaço mais adequado às necessidades dos usuários, com atenção à inclusão, ao acolhimento, ao cuidado e à continuidade da assistência.

A nova unidade substitui o espaço utilizado anteriormente nos fundos do Ambulatório de Especialidades, que apresentava limitações de estrutura diante do crescimento da demanda e da complexidade dos serviços. Os pacientes em acompanhamento passam a receber atendimento na Casa do Autista, junto da equipe multiprofissional do CTEA. A mudança mantém a continuidade dos tratamentos e o vínculo entre profissionais, pacientes e familiares.

“Estamos falando de cuidar de pessoas e de famílias inteiras. Não poderíamos aceitar que um atendimento tão importante continuasse limitado por falta de espaço. A Casa do Autista foi preparada para oferecer mais estrutura, acolhimento e dignidade. E nosso compromisso é avançar para atender também aqueles que ainda esperam por esse cuidado”, destacou o prefeito Henrique do Paraíso.

O vice-prefeito e secretário de Governo, Andre da Farmácia, reforçou que a nova unidade representa um avanço nas políticas públicas de inclusão e cuidado em Sumaré. “Essa é uma conquista importante para as famílias do município. A Casa do Autista oferece um espaço mais adequado para atender crianças, adolescentes e suas famílias. Nosso trabalho é fortalecer os serviços públicos, ampliar o acesso e garantir que o atendimento aconteça com respeito, acolhimento e dignidade”, afirmou.

A Casa do Autista conta com ambientes mais amplos e planejados para as necessidades específicas do atendimento às pessoas com TEA, além de equipamentos adequados e maior capacidade operacional.

A nova estrutura também amplia a capacidade do município para enfrentar a demanda reprimida. Mais de 400 pessoas aguardavam atendimento especializado. Com a ampliação da capacidade, a Prefeitura pretende aumentar de forma gradual a oferta de serviços, com a meta de reduzir e zerar a fila de espera.

“A Casa do Autista foi planejada para oferecer uma assistência mais qualificada, com estrutura adequada e equipe multiprofissional. A mudança do CTEA garante a continuidade dos atendimentos já existentes e cria condições para ampliar o acesso de novas famílias ao serviço especializado”, destacou o secretário municipal de Saúde, Frederico Almeida.

De acordo com o secretário, os fluxos e protocolos de atendimento da unidade também passam por organização para qualificar a assistência e fortalecer a articulação entre os serviços públicos e as instituições que atuam no atendimento especializado no município.

Para facilitar o acesso dos usuários e familiares à Casa do Autista, a Prefeitura alterou a rota dos ônibus que atendem a região e incluiu um novo ponto de parada próximo à unidade. A medida busca facilitar o deslocamento das famílias e garantir mais comodidade no acesso ao atendimento especializado.

A alteração amplia as opções de transporte para os usuários que precisam comparecer à Casa do Autista e contribui para evitar que dificuldades de deslocamento se tornem uma barreira à continuidade do acompanhamento.

A transferência do CTEA do Centro para a Casa da Autista marca uma nova etapa da assistência municipal às pessoas com TEA. A unidade reúne estrutura adequada, equipe multiprofissional, equipamentos e maior capacidade operacional para atender os pacientes que já integram a rede e ampliar o acesso de novas famílias ao atendimento especializado.

“Sumaré precisa ser uma cidade que acolhe e cuida das pessoas. Estamos ampliando a estrutura para chegar a quem já é atendido e também a quem ainda está esperando. O nosso compromisso é cuidar das pessoas e não deixar ninguém para trás”, concluiu o prefeito Henrique do Paraíso.

A Casa do Autista funciona de segunda a sexta-feira, das 7h às 17h, na Estrada Municipal Teodor Condiev, nº 1.211, Jardim Marchissoli.

Em caso de dúvidas, os responsáveis podem entrar em contato pelos telefones (19) 3399-5211 e (19) 3399-5212.

articles.title: Famílias esperam há anos por assentamento em área ocupada por fazenda | G1
articles.standfirst: Justiça reconheceu fazenda em Novo Mundo (MT) como propriedade da União e determinou a desocupação de parte da área. Desde então, mais de 74 famílias acampam ao entorno da propriedade.
articles.summary: Justiça reconheceu fazenda em Novo Mundo (MT) como propriedade da União e determinou a desocupação de parte da área. Desde então, mais de 10 famílias acampam ao entorno.
articles.body:
Famílias que vivem no Acampamento União Cinco Estrelas, em Novo Mundo (MT), aguardam há mais de duas décadas pela implantação de um assentamento da reforma agrária em uma área da Fazenda Cinco Estrelas, reconhecida pela Justiça como pertencente à União . Enquanto esperam em moradias improvisadas ao entorno da propriedade, os moradores enfrentam dificuldades de acesso à água, falta de infraestrutura e preocupação com a segurança .

A fazenda tem cerca de 4,3 mil hectares e integra o Projeto de Desenvolvimento Sustentável (PDS) Novo Mundo, criado pelo Instituto Nacional de Colonização e Reforma Agrária (Incra). Em 2025, o órgão publicou a relação de 74 famílias selecionadas para ocupar lotes no projeto .

Já em abril de 2026, a Justiça Federal determinou a desocupação de 2 mil hectares da fazenda dos atuais ocupantes, conforme o plano de ocupação elaborado pelo Incra . O prazo inicial de 30 dias foi ampliado para até a última semana deste mês, com possibilidade de prorrogação pela Justiça.

O g1 procurou a defesa da família Rodrigues da Cunha, citada na decisão, mas não obteve retorno até a última atualização desta reportagem.

Uma moradora local, que não quis ter a identidade divulgada, contou ao g1 que vive no acampamento há cerca de dez anos. Segundo ela, a falta de água tem afetado os moradores, os animais e as plantas mantidos pelas famílias.

“Está com mais de semana que o caminhão-pipa não vem trazer água para a gente aqui. Aí as plantas morrendo, a criação morrendo de sede. A gente também está sem água para nada. A gente precisa que isso aconteça o mais rápido possível, porque estamos esperando há anos”, afirmou.

Os moradores do Acampamento União Cinco Estrelas enfrentam dificuldades de acesso à água e falta de infraestrutura. — Foto: Arquivo pessoal

O g1 procurou a Prefeitura de Novo Mundo e a Secretaria Municipal de Obras para questionar o fornecimento de água e as condições de infraestrutura relatadas pelos moradores, mas não recebeu resposta até esta publicação.

Maria também relatou a presença de pessoas armadas na região e disse que os moradores têm preocupação com a própria segurança. Uma representante da Comissão Pastoral da Terra (CPT) , que não quis ter a identidade divulgada, informou que encaminhou essas denúncias dos moradores à Defensoria Pública da União, o Ministério Público Federal e a Agência Nacional de Mineração.

A Polícia Militar informou que realiza o policiamento na região com equipes da Patrulha Rural, da Força Tática do 15º Comando Regional e da unidade local de Novo Mundo . Segundo a corporação, denúncias recebidas na área foram apuradas nos últimos meses, mas não houve flagrantes que resultassem em detenções ou apreensões de armas.

A polícia informou ainda que a única prisão realizada no local nos últimos meses ocorreu em agosto, por violência doméstica.

Um morador local, que não quis ter a identidade divulgada, está acampado há mais de cinco anos. Ele vive no local com a esposa e faz trabalhos temporários para se manter enquanto aguarda a criação do assentamento.

“Depois de tanta espera, espero que se cumpra a determinação da Justiça e que se crie logo esse assentamento, pois as famílias têm sofrido muito todos esses anos debaixo da lona, aguentando esse sol escaldante. E agora, no início da chuvarada, ventos fortes estão desmanchando os barracos”, ressaltou.

Famílias que vivem no Acampamento União Cinco Estrelas, em Novo Mundo (MT), aguardam há mais de duas décadas pela implantação de um assentamento da reforma agrária. — Foto: Arquivo pessoal

A Fazenda Cinco Estrelas está localizada na Gleba Nhandu. A propriedade da União sobre a área foi reconhecida pela Justiça Federal, e o PDS Novo Mundo foi criado pelo Incra em 2002. No ano seguinte, a fazenda foi palco de um caso de trabalho escravo. À época, o Ministério do Trabalho registrou um dos maiores resgates, retirando da área 140 trabalhadores que viviam em condições degradantes .

A decisão do TRF-1 determinou a desocupação de 2 mil hectares para permitir o avanço da implantação do projeto. O cumprimento da ordem prevê a participação de órgãos públicos e prioriza medidas de conciliação e mediação.

A decisão judicial, por si só, não significa que o assentamento já esteja implantado. Ainda são necessárias providências para que a área seja efetivamente destinada às famílias selecionadas.

O Incra informou ao g1 que mantém o monitoramento da Fazenda Cinco Estrelas e que adotou medidas técnicas, administrativas e judiciais após tomar conhecimento de atividades de mineração na região.

Segundo o órgão, análises cartográficas e fundiárias identificaram pedidos de exploração de ouro que abrangem cerca de 4.346,63 hectares, praticamente toda a área da fazenda. O órgão apontou ainda que a Câmara Nacional de Conciliação Agrária acompanha o caso.

O Instituto afirmou que comunicou a Agência Nacional de Mineração (ANM), o Ministério Público Federal (MPF) e a Secretaria de Estado de Meio Ambiente (Sema) sobre a situação, diante da ausência de autorização do titular da área para as atividades. O Incra também informou ter adotado medidas judiciais relacionadas à posse e solicitado à Sema a suspensão das licenças.

Mesmo com a propriedade da União reconhecida pela Justiça e as 74 famílias selecionadas para o projeto, a implantação do assentamento ainda depende das providências necessárias ao cumprimento da decisão e à destinação efetiva das terras. Enquanto isso, famílias que esperam há anos pela área continuam vivendo no acampamento.

Já em abril de 2026, a Justiça Federal determinou a desocupação de 2 mil hectares da Fazenda Cinco Estrelas dos atuais ocupantes, conforme o plano de ocupação elaborado pelo Incra. — Foto: Arquivo pessoal

articles.title: Man dies after falling off Georgia roller coaster
articles.summary: Father of two thrown to his death from Goliath at Six Flags theme park
articles.body:
See more Toronto Sun on Google — save as a Preferred Source

A man has died at Six Flags Over Georgia theme park after falling off a 200-foot-tall roller coaster, CNN reported .

Cobb County Police said one man died and four others were injured Monday afternoon on the park's Goliath roller coaster ride. Local television stations WSB and 11Alive reported the man died after being thrown from his seat, falling and hitting the ride three times.

One witness said the man's fall was caught on the souvenir picture taken on the ride.

"He was in our pictures," the witness said. "He fell and hit the car three different times."

The witness said the man's body hit others on the ride before falling onto the roof of a haunted house below.

A woman said the man was on the ride with his son, while the man's wife and daughter were on the ground.

Another man and woman on the ride saw the man fly from his seat and bounce off the coaster three times.

"We were having a great time and to just screaming 'Oh my God, what is happening?'" the woman said. The couple said workers checked the safety harnesses before the ride began.

The incident left a train of riders behind the affected coaster stuck on a steep 200-foot lift hill incline. The park was evacuated, and news footage showed park workers carefully rescuing riders off of the coaster and down the steep, open-air stairwell leading back down to the ground.

In a statement, park owner and operator Six Flags, which also owns and operates Canada's Wonderland, said, "We are deeply saddened by the guest incident at our park today. Our thoughts and heartfelt condolences are with the guest's family, friends, and loved ones. We are also providing support to the guests and team members affected.

"The park team and local authorities responded immediately, and we are cooperating fully with local authorities as they complete their investigation. Out of respect for the family's privacy, we will not be sharing additional details at this time."

The cause of the incident isn't yet known. Goliath, manufactured by Bollinger and Mabillard, is classified as a "hypercoaster," meaning a roller coaster that stands at 200 feet to 300 feet tall. It has a 196-foot drop and reaches speeds of up to 112 km/h. By comparison, Canada's Wonderland's Behemoth , manufactured by the same company, is slightly larger and faster, standing at 230 feet tall and reaching speeds of up to 123 km/h.

articles.body: NEW DELHI: Karnataka chief minister DK Shivakumar on Tuesday denied that Rahul Gandhi pushed him during an opposition march in Delhi, saying the Congress leader had instead expressed concern for his safety amid the crowd. The remarks come as the BJP intensified its attack over a viral video of the incident.Earlier, Assam chief minister Himanta Biswa Sarma shared the footage on X, describing the episode as “public humiliation” and questioning whether Shivakumar would accept such treatment from the Congress leadership.“Rahul Gandhi did not push me during the protest held in Delhi. He showed concern for me by suggesting that I board the vehicle following behind, as the crowd of protesters was large,” Shivakumar told news agency PTI.“No one pushed me during the protest,” he asserted, taking a swipe at the BJP for spreading what he called misinformation, while suggesting that the party had “immense affection” for him.The remarks came as Sarma drew parallels with his own fallout with the Congress before joining the BJP, recalling that he had refused to accept what he considered humiliation.“In 2015, I refused to swallow humiliation, as a proud Assamese. God was kind to me,” Sarma wrote, asking whether Shivakumar would respond similarly.“The chief minister of Karnataka is not just an individual. He is a constitutional office, and the face of a State with a glorious history, a rich culture and deep pride,” he said, adding, “Will he bow to this public humiliation?”The video, recorded during Monday’s ‘March for Democracy’ towards the Supreme Court, purportedly shows Shivakumar moving towards the front of the procession, where Rahul Gandhi was walking alongside Congress MP Priyanka Gandhi Vadra and AISA chief Neha Bora. Gandhi appears to pull Shivakumar back by the collar of his kurta, after which security personnel move the Karnataka chief minister further back amid the crowd.The Karnataka BJP accused Gandhi of insulting a leader representing seven crore Kannadigas. State BJP president B Y Vijayendra termed the episode a display of arrogance and questioned the respect accorded to Shivakumar by the Congress leadership.Bengaluru South MP Tejasvi Surya also described the alleged incident as an “insult to the dignity of 7 crore Kannadigas”.Karnataka deputy chief minister G Parameshwara, however, said crowd management during protests was difficult and that security personnel were primarily responsible for protecting Rahul Gandhi. Shivakumar had moved towards that area and was “slightly pushed” amid the crowd, he said.The march was organised by opposition leaders and civil society representatives seeking to raise concerns over alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls. articles.title: Pope Leo diagnosed with lung cancer after surgeons remove part of right lung, Vatican says
articles.summary: Pope Leo XIV arrived at Gemelli Hospital in Rome for lung nodule removal after doctors said the growth was identified at a "very early stage." Doctors later confirmed he had a form of lung cancer.
articles.body: Pope Leo XIV underwent a procedure at Agostino Gemelli University Hospital in Rome to remove a small nodule on his lung Tuesday, the Vatican said. The 71-year-old pontiff underwent thoracic surgery to remove the lower lobe of his right lung after doctors confirmed he had lung adenocarcinoma, a form of lung cancer, according to a statement released by the Holy See Press Office. The diagnosis was confirmed through a tissue examination conducted during the operation, consistent with findings from preoperative tests, the Vatican said. The pope spent approximately three hours in the operating room, although the surgery itself lasted about 90 minutes. Doctors said the procedure was successful and there were no complications. POPE LEO ANNOUNCES TUMOR ON LUNG, SURGERY PLANNED IN 'NEXT FEW DAYS' Leo awoke normally following surgery and, after a brief observation period, returned to his room on the hospital's 10th floor, according to the statement from Dr. Luigi Carbone and Professor Stefano Margaritora. "Doctors found a small lump in the lung," Leo said after an Angelus address at St. Peter's Square on Monday. "It was identified at a very early stage and well situated." "The doctors consider it appropriate to intervene and so, following their advice, I decided to have surgery to remove it," he continued. "The surgery is already scheduled for the next few days. I thank you for your spiritual closeness and I rely on your prayer." The Vatican's latest statement confirmed that the surgery involved the removal of the lower lobe of the pope's right lung using a video-assisted technique. POPE LEO XIV BEGINS HISTORIC 4-DAY VISIT TO FRANCE The announcement comes as a surprise for the American-born pontiff, who has no previously known health problems and is known for maintaining an active lifestyle. POPE LEO VISITS SITE OF MIRACLE CURES, MEETS PEOPLE WHOSE UNEXPLAINED HEALINGS STUNNED DOCTORS Leo regularly plays tennis and swims at the papal summer retreat in Castel Gandolfo, according to The Associated Press. The pope is also scheduled to embark on a major international trip from Nov. 6–17, with planned stops in Uruguay, Argentina and Peru. It remains unclear whether his surgery and recovery will affect those travel plans. UKRAINE'S ATTACKS ON RUSSIA ARE PUSHING PUTIN CLOSER TO NEGOTIATING TABLE, TRUMP NATO AMBASSADOR SAYS In addition to addressing his health, Leo used his Sunday remarks to renew his appeal for peace in war-torn Ukraine, warning that the conflict continues to inflict suffering far beyond the country's borders. articles.title: After roughly $2.8 million in federal, county and state funding backed a conservation easement, a 58-acre Utah ranch where 70 cattle still graze was permanently protected from development while remaining working land
articles.summary: A 58-acre family ranch in Utah's Heber Valley has been permanently protected from urban development following a funding package backed by federal, state
articles.body: A 58-acre family ranch in Utah's Heber Valley has been permanently protected from urban development following a funding package backed by federal, state and local authorities. The Flying A Ranch Preserve, located in the historic North Fields area of Wasatch County, will remain an active agricultural property where 70 cattle continue to graze. The permanent conservation easement ensures the land cannot be subdivided into housing developments or commercial sites, preserving critical open space and water recharge systems in the rapidly growing region. According to updates released by the United States Department of Agriculture Natural Resources Conservation Service and non-profit land trust Utah Open Lands, the protection effort required nearly $2.8 million in total public funding. The financial agreement secures the working land while keeping ownership in private hands with the Giles family, who have farmed the area for generations.Funding structure and conservation termsThe protection of the 58-acre parcel relied on a combination of federal agricultural grants and regional open space preservation funds. Official records published by the Natural Resources Conservation Service indicate that the federal Agricultural Conservation Easement Program contributed significant funding toward purchasing the development rights. Additional funding was secured through Wasatch County open space bond revenues and state conservation grants administered by Utah authorities. Under the terms of the legally binding easement held by Utah Open Lands, the land will remain available for agricultural use, including livestock grazing, hay production and irrigation management. The deed restrictions attach permanently to the property title, preventing future owners from selling the land for residential subdivisions or commercial projects regardless of local zoning changes. Regional agricultural officials noted that preserving working farms helps maintain the local economy while protecting vital environmental systems in the Heber Valley.Protecting water systems and agricultural heritageThe Flying A Ranch sits within the North Fields, a scenic expanse of flood-irrigated farmland positioned beneath the Wasatch Mountains. Beyond livestock production, local environmental data highlighted by Utah Open Lands shows the agricultural acreage serves as an essential natural recharge zone for regional groundwater aquifers. Surface irrigation on unpaved fields allows water to seep slowly into the ground, replenishing underground aquifers that feed drinking wells throughout Wasatch County. Soil scientists and local agricultural groups noted that replacing these fields with asphalt and concrete would eliminate the natural filtration and aquifer storage capacity that the valley relies on. The property also provides winter habitat and migration corridors for local wildlife, including elk, mule deer and resident bird species moving through the Provo River watershed. Landowner Chadd Giles expressed relief that the long project had reached completion, preserving his family's working history on the land. "Dad's real glad this is done," said Chadd Giles in a statement published by Utah Open Lands regarding his father, Alan Giles. "He's sleeping better now that it is protected." With the conservation easement fully recorded, the Giles family retains full operational control of the ranch and can continue running their cattle herd without risk of forced sell-offs driven by rising property tax valuations and regional development pressures.Development pressures in the Heber ValleyThe preservation of the Flying A Ranch comes amid growing concerns over rapid population expansion and commercial development across Wasatch County. Reports published by Utah Open Lands and local news outlet TownLift detail how proximity to Salt Lake City and Park City has driven up real estate values throughout the Heber Valley, placing intense financial pressure on farming families to sell land to housing developers. The North Fields area has also been the subject of ongoing regional transportation discussions. The Utah Department of Transportation has conducted environmental impact studies to evaluate potential bypass routes designed to relieve traffic congestion along main thoroughfares in Heber City. Local conservation groups and residents have advocated for agricultural easements to ensure key agricultural corridors remain intact while state planners assess road design options. The designation of agricultural conservation easements in the valley provides formal federal recognition of the area's agricultural significance, opening up further funding streams for nearby landowners seeking similar protections. Utah Open Lands confirmed that the Flying A Ranch project forms part of a larger regional conservation effort known as the Heartland of the Heber Valley initiative. articles.title: In 2021, Philadelphia Airport used 90,000 cubic yards of recycled-bottle foamed glass beneath an aircraft apron; it diverted an estimated 83 million bottles and cut at least six months from construction
articles.summary: Philadelphia International Airport revolutionizes construction by using 90,000 cubic yards of foamed glass aggregate made from recycled bottles, reducing emissions and project timeline significantly.
articles.body: An aircraft apron needs a stable base, but at sites with soft, compressible soil, the weight of fill and pavement can cause settlement. The soil compresses slowly over months, so builders may need to wait for that movement or treat the ground before paving, which adds time to a job that an airport usually wants finished quickly. Glass bottles posed a second problem. Once collected in bulk, they had to be recycled or they would simply be buried. One airport tied the two problems together by using a very lightweight material made from bottles.The remaining overnight apron at Philadelphia International AirportPhiladelphia International Airport’s newsroom describes the remaining overnight apron as a 58,000 square foot project on the northwest corner of the airfield, next to the FedEx facilities in Cargo City. Philadelphia International Airport held a groundbreaking ceremony for its new aircraft parking apron on July 14, 2021, after contract work had begun in late 2020. Designed to accommodate up to eight planes, the apron used ultra-lightweight foamed glass aggregate to reduce pressure on the underlying soil and address settlement concerns. Site conditions explain that choice. AMay 2021 International Society for Concrete Pavements article by Amy M. Dean quotes airport senior project manager Larry Allen saying the site near the Delaware River has a high water table and soft soils, creating a high risk of settlement.How bottles become foamed glass aggregateThe same article describes how the material is made. Glass bottles of any size and color are taken to a plant, milled into powder, and mixed with a foaming agent. The article states that the aggregate is made from 100% post-consumer recycled glass and is 85% lighter than quarried aggregate, and that, unlike styrofoam-based lightweight fills, it is not flammable or degradable.Ninety thousand cubic yards and an estimated 83 to 85 million bottles diverted from landfillsThe International Society for Concrete Pavements reported that the Philadelphia International Airport project used approximately 90,000 cubic yards of foamed glass aggregate. AeroAggregates’ Archie Filshill told the ISCP article that the material diverted the equivalent of more than 83 million glass bottles from landfills and reduced delivery-truck trips by 6,000. The airport announcement about winning the award uses the same amount of aggregate and 85 million bottles. These figures regarding bottles are estimates from different times. The airport’s award announcement gives the same 90,000 cubic yards but puts the diversion at 85 million bottles. It adds that the material came from a manufacturer only six miles from the airport, which led to an 85% reduction in shipping-related greenhouse gas emissions, though it does not explain how that figure was calculated. Shorter construction and fewer heavy equipment trips cut emissions further, the announcement says. articles.title: Work to turn derelict site into Wiltshire Museum to begin
articles.summary: Preparation work is due to start at Assize Court in Devizes within weeks.
articles.body:
The £14.5m transformation of a derelict courthouse building into the new home of a county museum is set to begin in weeks.

The Grade II* listed Assize Court in Devizes was built in 1835 and has been unused since it closed in the 1980s.

It is expected to reopen in 2030 as the new home of Wiltshire Museum - which is currently based in a smaller building in Devizes and has a number of collections, including gold items found in burial sites near Stonehenge.

Museum director David Dawson said things were "about to get very exciting" as work to prepare the building for the renovation would commence "over the next few weeks".

Wiltshire Museum was granted planning permission by Wiltshire Council to restore Assize Court in August 2025.

"It [the building] gives us everything we need...we'll have a fantastic state-of-the-art exhibition gallery with conditions that mean we can borrow items from national collections the whole year round," Dawson said.

"We'll have dedicated facilities for schools and everything on tap for them...everything will be in one place," he added.

Plan for £303m bypass dropped by government

1970s theatre 'not worth spending millions on'

Plan for 2,000 EV charging points gets green light

As well as exhibition space, the new museum site will have a cafe, learning space, multi-use event space and gardens.

Speaking about the future of its current site, Dawson said: "Sadly there's not enough space over there to hold all the collections...it will become a collections discovery centre, a place where people can come and research the collections

"We've been here for 150 years, we'll still be here for probably another 150," he added.

Dawson said more than £12.5m had been raised so far to finance the £14.5m project.

"We're still putting in grant bids and we're very confident we will close that gap before all the bills are due - we are pretty much there," he said.

He added that the imminent enabling works were expected to take 12 weeks, with contractors due on site in the new year.

Nicholas Elliott, trustee of Devizes Assize Court Trust, said preparation work starting was an "exciting moment".

He added that the site had been "a blight" in the area for years and the redevelopment would make the community proud.

articles.title: UK spy chief says Iran is stepping up targeting of military bases
articles.summary: MI5 chief says 50 arrests were made in past year to disrupt Iran-led operations.
articles.body:
The head of the United Kingdom’s domestic spy agency has said Iran is ramping up attempts to strike sensitive military targets after a series of incidents at airbases in Britain, even as Tehran has denied any involvement.

In his annual speech, M15 Director-General Ken McCallum on Tuesday said there had been a major shift in Tehran’s calculus this year and that “Iranian ambitions to come at harder targets, like military sites”.

McCallum’s warning came after UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham said Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) was “ almost certainly ” behind a suspected plot against Royal Air Force (RAF) Fairford, an airbase used by US bombers to carry out strikes on Iran. The incident prompted the United States to withdraw its military jets from the facility over security concerns earlier this month.

British police declared a major incident after three “suspicious” vans drove close to the RAF Fairford airbase in Gloucestershire on September 27. Five British men in their 20s were arrested “on suspicion of committing offences under the Explosives Act”, but all were released on bail.

Police said they found a supply of petrol in three vans linked to the suspects, but no explosives. The men were later released without charge on police bail “under stringent conditions”.

Two others were arrested later, including a British-Iranian national, but were later released. None of the men have been charged.

Two Latvian men were arrested for trespassing at RAF Molesworth, which is used by the US military and NATO for intelligence operations, on Friday. The men were also released on bail.

UK Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband said on Monday that the government was sanctioning two Iranians for their “role in facilitating or engaging in hostile activity on behalf of the Iranian regime”.

One is Ruhollah Bazghandi, the head of IRGC counterespionage operations, and the other is Shahram Ali Reza Tamarzadeh Jakki, whom British officials described as a facilitator for Iran’s Zindashti criminal network.

McCallum said he could not speak about the recent incident at RAF Fairford because it was an ongoing investigation, but added, “The RAF Fairford incident … is ⁠not unique. There have been other examples, not just in the UK but around the world.”

The spy chief said UK authorities had carried out 50 arrests over the past year to disrupt Iran-linked operations.

However, he said he doubted Iran’s ability to launch complex attacks, perhaps using explosive drones, due to the limited sophistication of operatives Tehran used in the UK.

“Given what we’ve actually seen in practice in the UK ⁠in recent years, that has not been anywhere near [that] level of capability,” McCallum said.

“That said, clearly it is the case that in countries closer to its own homeland, the IRGC has quite ⁠deep experience of using more conventional and hybrid technology in a more aggressive and ⁠sophisticated way,” the MI5 boss added.

Tehran has rejected accusations ‌of involvement in the Fairford incident or any other accusations of harmful activity in Britain.

articles.title: Research crew searching for Amelia Earhart plane arrives on remote island in South Pacific
articles.summary: An expedition has reached a remote island in the South Pacific where it believes Amelia Earhart’s lost plane may have landed when the famed female pilot disappeared nearly 90 years ago.
articles.body: An expedition has reached a remote island in the South Pacific where it believes Amelia Earhart’s lost plane may have landed when the famed female pilot disappeared nearly 90 years ago. A group of researchers with the Archaeological Legacy Institute and Purdue University arrived Tuesday at the island of Nikumaroro, the university announced in a press release. The crewmembers will then hike their way toward a lagoon where an anomaly was spotted on satellite images. Earhart mysteriously vanished in the summer of 1937 while flying around the world, hoping to be the first woman to accomplish such a feat. But on the morning of July 2, 1937, the U.S. Coast Guard ship lost contact with Earhart and her navigator as they attempted to fly to Howland Island. The last transmissions from the two-person crew was Earhart reporting unexpected cloudy weather before she told the Coast Guard crew that she could not find them and that her plane was running out of a fuel. She and her navigator, Fred Noonan, were never heard from again. It’s believed that Earhart crashed-landed but a weekslong search by the U.S. government at the time found no trace of the plane. Nearly a century later, the historic female aviator’s disappearance remains one of the world’s great mysteries. The island of Nikumaroro is very close to where Earhart was at the time of her last radio transmissions. It’s an uninhabited island that’s part of the Phoenix Islands belonging to the Republic of Kiribati. Some artifacts have been found on the island that indicate Earhart and Noonan’s plane may have landed there, including glass bottles from the 1930s and a woman’s makeup compact. It’s expected to take the crew at least three weeks between travel and searching the island before they return home, according to Purdue University. The project is a “huge logistical feat,” according to Steve Schultz, senior vice president and general counsel at Purdue University. He is one of three members of the crew from Purdue and noted last week that moving more than a dozen people with large amounts of equipment has become its own obstacle. “Even when you think you’ve done enough planning and preparation, everything has to fall into place once you’re underway,” he said. “The amazing thing is that it has been a series of small victories.” Now that they’ve reached Nikumaroro, they’ll have to hack through heavy vegetation as they make their way to the lagoon and then attempt to identify the object as Earhart’s lost Lockheed Electra 10E. The journey is further complicated by very large crabs that inhabit the island, preventing the crew from camping on the land. Each night, the crewmembers will have to return to their boat and sleep in pods below deck. The expedition is being led by Richard Pettigrew, executive director of the Archaeological Legacy Institute. He said in a statement prior to the team embarking on the journey that the project comes with “an array of strong feelings.” “I feel truly lucky to be in a position to possibly solve one of the greatest mysteries of all time, whether or not that happens,” Pettigrew said. If the crew does end up finding Earhart’s plane, Purdue University’s research foundation hopes to raise money to excavate the aircraft and bring it back to Indiana.

articles.title: MI5 chief warns against overstating Russian interference in Brexit vote
articles.summary: It comes after Andy Burnham said Moscow had tried to interfere in the 2016 referendum.
articles.body:
MI5 chief Sir Ken McCallum has said there was Russian interference in the the Brexit referendum, but warned against overstating its impact on the result.

It comes after Prime Minister Andy Burnham provoked a backlash from some Brexit campaigners by saying it was "clear" there had been interference by Moscow in the 2016 vote.

Sir Ken said it was "a matter of public record" that there was interference in the referendum by online trolls and bots.

However, he suggested Russian trolls would be "delighted" to be front page news again, "despite the comparative unimpressiveness" of their efforts.

He added: "There is a really important difference between interference attempted and outcome swayed.

"I am a little bit anxious that we don't play into our adversaries' hands by making these trolls look 10ft tall."

Conservative deputy leader Alex Burghart branded Sir Ken's comments "an extraordinary slap down to the prime minister".

In an interview released on Monday, Burnham told The Rest is Politics podcast that upon arriving in Downing Street, he had asked if there had been Russian interference in the 2016 vote, adding: "I've had the clear answer that, yes, there was."

He did not provide details about the extent or nature of Russian activities during the interview, and when pressed on the subject in the House of Commons on Monday afternoon appeared to be less definitive.

The PM denied claims from Conservative leader Kemi Badenoch that he was implying the referendum result was illegitimate because of Russian interference.

He said it was a "matter of record" that Russia sought to interfere in the 2019 general election , adding: "We think it is inconceivable that this was the first time".

A No 10 spokesperson also clarified that while the prime minister believed it was highly likely Russia tried to influence the referendum result, he did not believe those efforts were successful.

The Conservatives accused Burnham of making an "embarrassing retreat" after "being caught out trying question the legitimacy of the referendum result".

It is inconceivable to think Russia did not try to interfere in Brexit vote, says PM

MI5 chief warns of threats to UK from Russia, Iran and AI

Is Burnham right to blame Russia for spreading online disinformation?

Answering questions after his annual speech at MI5's London headquarters earlier, Sir Ken said: "It is openly on the record that Russia Today and Sputnik and other Russian media organisations came in pretty strongly around the referendum.

"And it is also a matter of open source record that there was a certain amount of interference attempted through trolls and bots and so forth."

He added that he agreed "strongly" with the PM that there was a hack and leak during the 2019 general election campaign.

However, he raised concerns about the impact of the debate on Russian interference.

"It is kind of up to us how far we allow our various adversaries to divide us," Sir Ken said.

"And I'm a little bit worried that if we all stay in this debate for another few days, that Russian trolls who didn't appear to do all that much at various points over the years, they'll be delighted because they are front page news again despite the comparative unimpressiveness of what they do at all points along the journey."

Reform UK leader Nigel Farage has accused Burnham of lying, saying there was "no Russian interference" in the referendum.

Meanwhile, former Prime Minister Boris Johnson said that in 2016, when he became foreign secretary, the security services had told him "there was no evidence of any successful interference in the 2016 referendum, by Russia or any other power".

He added: "Either the security services have changed their view - which would be very odd - or Burnham is lying about what he has been told."

In 2020, a parliamentary report did not reach a firm conclusion on whether Russia had tried to intervene in UK elections and referendums, but criticised the government for failing to fully assess and counter the threat from Russian "troll" accounts on social media.

articles.title: 13 dead, 7 hospitalised after boat capsizes in Bihar's Vaishali; 3-4 still missing
articles.summary: PATNA: At least 13 people died after a boat capsized in the Ganga in Rampur Shyamchand panchayat under Raghopur police station limits in Vaishali district
articles.body: PATNA: At least 13 people died after a boat capsized in the Ganga in Rampur Shyamchand panchayat under Raghopur police station limits in Vaishali district on Tuesday night.Seven people are undergoing treatment, while three to four others are still missing.The passengers, mostly children and young men, were travelling to attend a feast at the house of Singheshwar Rai near Mata Maharani Sthan in Bhagatan Tola when the small boat capsized midstream at around 8.30pm.After receiving information about the incident, local residents rushed to the spot and launched rescue efforts. Several people were pulled out of the water and taken to the primary health centre at Raghopur Fatehpur for treatmentPolice and administrative officials reached the spot after being alerted. An SDRF team, along with local divers, launched a rescue operation to trace those missing.The deceased included Pinky Kumari (13), daughter of Doman Rai; Ankita Kumari (6), and Sunita Kumari, daughters of Raj Kishore Rai; Aryan Kumar, son of Girdhari Rai; Alisha Kumari (18) and Siki Kumari, daughters of Suresh Rai; Bhonu Kumari, daughter of Rampravesh Rai; Meera Kumari, daughter of Lalu Rai; and Naman Kumar (10), son of Mukesh Rai. All were residents of Rampur Shyamchand village. The identities of the remaining deceased were yet to be confirmed, police said.Vaishali SP Shubhank Mishra, who also rushed to the spot, had earlier confirmed that five bodies had been recovered from the river and said that around four to five people were still missing. The death toll has since risen to 13, while rescue efforts continue to locate those unaccounted for.Mishra said, “Thirteen people have died and their bodies have been fished out. Three to four are still missing, and seven rescued people are undergoing treatment.Bihar CM Samrat Choudhary expressed grief over the tragedy and extended his condolences to the bereaved families. articles.title: An Iowa farmer whose family farms 400 acres says crops barely cover taxes; after a solar project won a key county permit, he says leases are running about $1,200 per acre and hopes most of his land can join
articles.summary: An Iowa farmer facing falling crop prices and rising machinery costs says leasing his land for solar panels could provide a vital source of income.
articles.body: An Iowa farmer facing falling crop prices and rising machinery costs says leasing his land for solar panels could provide a vital source of income. His comments came after a major renewable energy project received an important local planning approval. The Mills County Zoning Board unanimously approved the proposed Folsom Lake Solar Project, a 3,200-acre renewable energy development near the Missouri River and west of Interstate 29 in south-western Iowa. Local farmer Tom Green, whose family farms 400 acres in the area, welcomed the decision. He confirmed that he hopes to include most of his land in the project. According to reporting by Omaha television station KETV NewsWatch 7, Green said traditional row-crop farming in the region has become increasingly difficult to keep financially sustainable. "We're getting (crop) prices that we got in the 1950s," Green told KETV. "Everybody else's money goes up, farmers' (crop) prices go down, and the machinery (cost) goes up."Guaranteed income over crop market volatilityDeveloper Orion Renewable Energy Group first contacted local landowners about the Folsom Lake Solar Project four to five years ago. The company offered them long-term leases for their land. Green said the developer is offering around $1,200 per acre each year. This would provide a steady income compared with changing grain prices and rising farming costs. "It's running about $1,200 an acre," Green told KETV. "It's a very good deal. Right now, with the farming and the tariffs and things like that, we're hardly making enough to pay taxes." Another local farmer, Rick Frost, also supported the solar project. He pointed out that parts of Mills County have poorer soil than other farming areas in Iowa. "Our soil quality here is much less in many parts of Iowa," Frost explained in comments broadcast by KETV. "It's good for the soil to give it a rest… I'll be able to retire someday. And the land will be in a profitable state. So I can pass on to my children."Regional power production and tax revenueThe Folsom Lake Solar Project is designed to generate 800 megawatts of electricity annually once completed. Sazzy Gourley, senior project development manager at Orion Renewable Energy Group, told KETV that the project would produce enough electricity to power around 144,000 homes in Iowa. "There's a lot of need for new power generation in the area. So the scale of our project is designed to meet that need," Gourley told KETV. She added that the company would publicly identify the buyers purchasing the electricity before building permits are issued. Figures presented by Orion Renewable Energy Group show that the project is expected to generate $36 million in local tax revenue over its planned 35-year operating life. The developer also plans to provide millions of pounds in additional grant funding through the Community Foundation for Western Iowa. The project is expected to create 10 to 15 permanent jobs to operate and maintain the site, along with hundreds of temporary construction jobs.Neighboring compensation and remaining permitsTo address the project's impact on nearby residents, Orion Renewable Energy Group confirmed that it will offer direct financial payments to people living within a third of a mile of the solar installations who are not leasing their land to the project. Official notices from Mills County confirm that the zoning board's recommendation sends the application to the Mills County Board of Supervisors for further review and public hearings. Orion Renewable Energy Group plans to obtain the remaining environmental and construction permits over the next year. articles.title: China sentences three people to death for running Myanmar scam centres
articles.summary: Dozens more were imprisoned for their involvement in telecommunications fraud, trafficking, prostitution and murder.
articles.body:
A court in eastern China has sentenced three members of a criminal gang to death for operating a network of scam centres in Myanmar.

In a statement released on Tuesday, Quanzhou Intermediate People’s Court, a high court in southeastern Fujian province, said it had sentenced Wei Huairen, Chen Dawei and Liao Jingfang for their involvement in the “Wei family criminal gang”.

The syndicate was involved in crimes including drug trafficking, organised prostitution, illegal casino operations, telecommunications fraud and the murder of at least two Chinese nationals.

The court said Wei was one of the group’s leaders and was found guilty of several crimes, including murder.

Three other members were jailed for life, while 55 others were handed sentences ranging from three years and three months to 24 years in prison.

The court said the gang’s operations netted more than $1.8bn.

Chinese state broadcaster CCTV on Tuesday described the gang as operating 14 “large-scale” compounds and having lured “thousands” of Chinese nationals with promises of high wages to Myanmar.

The verdict comes as Beijing intensified its crackdown on cross-border scam networks operating in southeast Asia, where scam parks have become an industrial-scale business.

The International Organization for Migration in July warned that scam centres in southeast Asia employ as many as 300,000 workers and use online schemes to defraud people in the West, many of them elderly.

Many of those conducting the online scams are trafficked foreign nationals forced to work in prison-like compounds.

articles.title: Photos: French protests over school conditions swell
articles.summary: Mass rallies backing high school protests continue across France, piling pressure on President Emmanuel Macron.
articles.body:
Tens of thousands of people have joined rallies across France in support of protesting high school students, boosting a movement that is posing a major challenge to President Emmanuel Macron as his term in office winds down.

Some 161,500 people turned out on Tuesday according to the Interior Ministry, more than double the 71,500 it reported for Thursday’s nationwide demonstrations.

Unions helping to organise the rallies put the countrywide turnout at 480,000.

Although most of Tuesday’s demonstrations were peaceful, violence broke out on the sidelines of one of two marches in Paris, where the Interior Ministry said 41,500 people took part.

Thousands also marched in the cities of Nantes, Lyon, Lens, Strasbourg, Toulouse, Bordeaux and Marseille, according to police.

The student movement sprang up last month, with students blocking the entrances to many schools to demand better classroom conditions.

What many see as a heavy-handed police response to the students prompted more people to join Tuesday’s demonstrations.

Police have opened investigations into 34 allegations of violence against demonstrators.

Some 147 teaching staff have been injured in the protests, the Education Ministry said.

On Monday, Macron urged restraint from protesters, saying the issues “deserve time, consultations, discussion and respect”.

articles.title: US Supreme Court agrees to hear watchdog case on Elon Musk’s DOGE records
articles.summary: The Trump administration argues that DOGE is exempt from freedom of information requirements.
articles.body:
The United States Supreme Court has agreed to hear arguments in a watchdog’s lawsuit seeking public records about trillionaire Elon Musk’s Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE).

The high court is intervening on Tuesday for a second time in Citizens for Responsibility and Ethics (CREW) in Washington’s case, which seeks access to DOGE records from its operations in the early days of US President Donald Trump’s second term. The Trump administration asked the court to hear the case.

Last year, the high court reined in a district court’s order for the government to produce DOGE-related records to CREW. The high court’s conservative majority concluded in June 2025 that US District Judge Christopher Cooper ruled too broadly in ordering documents to be turned over to the group.

CREW claims DOGE is a federal agency and therefore is subject to the Freedom of Information Act (FOIA).

The Trump administration argues that DOGE is exempt from FOIA’s requirements as a presidential advisory body.

Cooper ruled in CREW’s favour and ordered expedited processing of the group’s records request. An appeals court panel also sided with CREW.

The Trump administration claims the panel ignored the Supreme Court’s direction to consider separation-of-powers concerns and intruded on the “autonomy and confidentiality” of presidential advisers.

“Subjecting advisory bodies to intrusive discovery triggers the very concerns that Congress sought to avoid by excluding presidential advisory bodies from FOIA’s reach,” US Department of Justice lawyers wrote.

The administration also says the appeals court impermissibly authorised the plaintiffs to take a sworn deposition of DOGE acting administrator Amy Gleason.

CREW says the appeals court fully complied with the Supreme Court’s previous order. The group also asserts that the public has a right to know how DOGE helped the administration carry out a sweeping overhaul of government operations in 2025.

“Undisputed facts in the public record — including the President’s statements — confirmed that (DOGE) was wielding enormous independent authority across the federal government,” CREW lawyers wrote.

In a statement Tuesday, CREW lawyer Nikhel Sus said the lower courts have uniformly ruled that it is entitled to records that could help the court determine whether DOGE wields the type of authority that would make it subject to the Freedom of Information Act.

“We will continue to pursue transparency for the American people, who deserve to know the details of the Trump Administration’s efforts to unilaterally remake the federal government,” Sus said in the statement.

DOGE said it had slashed tens of billions of dollars in expenditures, but its claims were difficult for outside financial experts to verify.

Federal auditors found that some of DOGE’s reported savings across contract, grant and ⁠lease terminations were incorrect, lacked supporting evidence or included terminations that were already under way when DOGE was established, according to ⁠a report by the Government Accountability Office.
